dog.description_text: Meet Marnie, a very cute girl with unique coloring that makes her truly one of a kind! Marnie was found as a stray, so we don't have any history about her previous home. She has been fearful in the shelter, but she is warming up nicely when given a slow, considerate approach. Marnie enjoys treats and is showing her sweet side by jumping into her handler's lap. With patience, kindness, and time to build trust, Marnie is sure to continue coming out of her shell and show just how special she can be.
dog.name: Marnie
